Section.title: Introduction
Section.SectionContent:
This implementation guide describes how immunization events are exchanged between Electronic Health Record systems (EHR-S) and Immunization Information Systems (IIS) using HL7 Version 2.5.1 messages. It is a showcase guide whose only purpose is to exercise every feature of the IGAMT export.

Key words SHALL, SHOULD and MAY are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.

A conformant sender SHALL populate every element with usage R and SHALL NOT populate elements with usage X.

Section.title: Purpose
Section.SectionContent:
The purpose of this guide is threefold:
  1. Define the Z22 unsolicited vaccination update and its Z23 acknowledgement.
  2. Define the Z44 query and Z42 response for evaluated history and forecast.
    1. Query parameters
    2. Response grouping
      • Evaluated history
      • Forecast
  3. Illustrate laboratory reporting (ORU^R01) of serology results.

Sub script, super script, strikethrough, coloured text and highlighted text are all used somewhere in real guides.

Section.title: Scope
Section.SectionContent: Immunization information systems (IIS) are confidential, population based, computerized databases that record all immunization doses administered by participating providers to persons residing within a given geopolitical area. Immunization information systems (IIS) are confidential, population based, computerized databases that record all immunization doses administered by participating providers to persons residing within a given geopolitical area. Immunization information systems (IIS) are confidential, population based, computerized databases that record all immunization doses administered by participating providers to persons residing within a given geopolitical area. At the point of clinical care, an IIS can provide consolidated immunization histories for use by a vaccination provider in determining appropriate client vaccinations. At the population level, an IIS provides aggregate data on vaccinations for use in surveillance and program operations, and in guiding public health action with the goals of improving vaccination rates and reducing vaccine-preventable disease. Section.SectionContent:
• Unsolicited vaccination record update (VXU^V04)
  • Acknowledgement (ACK)

ORC|RE||197023^DCS|||||||^Clerk^Myron||^Pediatric^MARY^^^^MD^^HL70010^^^^NPI
RXA|0|1|20261104||20^DTaP^CVX|0.5|mL^mL^UCUM||00^New immunization record^NIP001|||||0039F|20270630|PMC^sanofi pasteur^MVX|||CP|A

RXA|0|1|20261104||20^DTaP^CVX|0.5|mL^mL^UCUM||00^New immunization record^NIP001||||||0039F|20270630|PMC^sanofi pasteur^MVX|||CP|A
RXR|IM^Intramuscular^HL70162|LA^Left Arm^HL70163


Receivers SHALL respond with a Z23 ACK.
ConformanceProfile.preDef:
The Z22 profile is used by an EHR-S to send an immunization history (new doses, historical doses and refusals) for one patient to an IIS.
  • Trigger: a dose is recorded or a record is corrected.
  • Response: Z23 acknowledgement.
ConformanceProfile.author: Dana Whitfield, MPH, Rahul Iyer

ConformanceStatement.description: Within one ORDER group, OBX-4 (Observation Sub-ID) SHALL link the VIS document type (69764-9) with its presentation date (29769-7).
MSH-21.1 (Entity Identifier) shall contain the value 'Z22'.
MSH-21.2 (Namespace ID) shall contain the value 'CDCPHINVS'.
If RXA-9.1 (Identifier) contains the value '00', then at least one occurrence of OBSERVATION.OBX-3.1 (Identifier) shall contain the value '64994-7'.
The message SHALL contain exactly one PID segment and at least one ORDER group. A message with multiple patients SHALL be rejected (MSA-1 = AR).
If RXA-20 (Completion Status) contains the value 'RE', then RXR (Pharmacy/Treatment Route) shall not be valued.

Predicate.description: If RXA-20 (Completion Status) is valued "CP" or "PA".

SegmentRef.predicate: If RXA-20 (Completion Status) is valued "CP" or "PA".
SegmentRef.label: RXR_IZ

tr.td: Funding eligibility. Required for every newly administered dose.
Disease with presumed immunity (fixed code example: varicella).
Dose number in series (constant value example).
Document type of the Vaccine Information Statement (VIS).
Date the VIS was presented to the patient or guardian.
Only contraindication observations are allowed for refusals.

Segment.title: PID
Segment.name: PID
Segment.postDef:

PID|1||432155^^^MYEHR^MR||Patient^Johnny^New^^^^L|Lastname^Sally^^^^^M|20260814|M||2106-3^White^CDCREC|123 Any St^^Somewhere^WI^54000^USA^L


Patient matching relies on PID-3, PID-5, PID-6, PID-7 and PID-8.
Segment.preDef: The PID segment is used by all applications as the primary means of communicating patient identification information. This segment contains permanent patient identifying and demographic information that, for the most part, is not likely to change frequently.
Segment.label: PID_IZ
